text:
Ava: Hey docs team — PR ready for review: rfc/serving-migration-guide updates + SDK snippet parity. PR #3421. Can reviewers @Jonah @Priya @Ken take a look? Hoping to merge in tomorrow's docs merge window (12:00 PT). Main asks: tone consistency, avoid first-person 'we', prefer 'inference runtime' over 'model serving' (style lexicon), and fix a broken link to the dedicated vs private table. Also added a Python snippet — need TS parity.

DocsBot: docs-preview generated — https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3421 — status: failing (2 broken links, 1 lint error).

Jonah: grabbing this now. Quick Q — which sections need voice adjustments? point me to lines?

Ava: lines ~120-160: change "we recommend" -> "Redwood recommends"; replace "model serving" instances with "inference runtime" per lexicon. Also headers should use sentence case (e.g., "Best practices for batching" not "Best Practices For Batching").

Priya: I'll take SDK snippets — will sync TS parity. Is there a unit test for snippet outputs? @Ava

Ava: Not yet. I added example outputs inline; keep them deterministic and trimmed. Avoid long multi-line outputs.

Ken: I'll triage the broken links + lint. The link to the dedicated/private table looks like the anchor changed in migration — likely /docs/deployments#capacity-comparison. Also spotted a trailing space in the markdown link that breaks it.

Jonah: Also small wording nit in "Private" section: avoid saying "secure" by itself — prefer "isolated" and call out "customer-managed keys" per compliance lexicon. I'll send a tiny patch.

Priya: TS snippet parity done locally. Two small differences: param name and optional flags. Will push a follow-up.

DocsBot: docs-preview updated — https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3421 — status: failing (1 broken link remaining).

Ken: found the remaining broken link — relative-path typo. Pushed fix in commit ken/docs-fix-3421. Also fixed linter (line length + list punctuation). PTAL.

Ava: Thanks — can reviewers prioritize this? Plan: merge after >=2 approvals and green docs-preview. If you can't review before 11:30 PT please ping and I'll gate.

Maya: Can we add a short migration checklist at the top? Several users asked in PR. I can draft a 5-bullet list.

Ava: Yes please. Keep it to 5 bullets max. Call out "risk: caching behavior" and "rollback: pin previous model version" explicitly.

Jonah: Approved after wording tweak in Private section. :thumbsup:

Priya: Approved (snippet parity verified). :white_check_mark:

Ken: Approved, docs-preview is green. :rocket:

Ava: Awesome — merging in the 12:00 PT slot. Thanks all. :tada:

DocsBot: Merge executed by Ava — PR #3421 merged at 2040012390.
